title: ErasureMemberArrived
description:
`erasure_member_arrived` — an item mapped into an erasure after its declaration, by the arrival
trigger, the closing survey or the straggler detector. Projected as a `late` member row.

parent.description: The container member of the same erasure that holds the item.

ErasureArrivalSource.description: What found the item an [`ErasureMemberArrived`] record maps.

oneOf.description: The arrival trigger, as the item was written into the erasure's scope.
The closing survey, which seals the erasure's scope.
The straggler detector, after the scope was sealed.

ErasureMemberRef.description: An item an erasure member names: its table, as the DDL spells it, and its id.

ErasureMemberTable.description:
A table whose rows an erasure member can name. Serializes as the DDL spells the table.
Ordered by declaration, so it can key a map that serializes with stable bytes.
